## Current D3 and R3 reasoning; specific unchanged inheritance

The accepted D3 change is two net-isolated local F.Cu regions, 232.7851 and
206.4076 mm², with direct full-land connections and exact 3.3-to-14 mm flares over
5.35 mm. The current native/plot and independent Boolean witnesses establish the
new broad heat-spreading path; supply copper is not connected to GND. Parts,
positions, pads, paste, stack, outlines, holes and occupied mechanical geometry
are unchanged. Pod bytes are unchanged. FR8 engineering, renewed FR9 routing/
strict layout and FR10 fabrication/registered assembly supply the current causal
chain. Historical tiny-land 55 K/W / approximately 86 °C and pending-R3 statements
are explicitly superseded without editing history.

The independent electrical and layout/power reviewers freshly judged the actual
geometry applicable to the reference-informed **110 K/W plus 20 °C neighboring-
board prototype allocation**: 0.4725 W and 60 °C measured local air give
131.975 °C, 18.025 °C below the 150 °C absolute ceiling. That ceiling is not an
operating target. Restricted 130/+20 has only 8.575 °C headroom; 150/+20 reaches
150.875 °C and fails. Neither actual theta nor neighboring coupling is a measured,
analytically bounded or maker-guaranteed maximum. The physical full-land local
path—not a multiplier alone—supports this bounded prototype judgment. U10/F1
heat, ventilation and calibrated full-load steady-state falsifiers remain; no
channel/current/ambient/duty or mission reduction is approved.

Qualified Panasonic ERJ-3EKF68R0V carrier R3 retains the larger registered
1.80 × 1.00 × 0.65 mm envelope, finite roundrect overlap and maximum two compatible
reflows. Its actual power-limited DC RCWV is approximately 2.60768 V; inherited
25 V selection text is not continuous permission. The source-series capacitive
clock role, ±6% common/±4% branch sensitivity, exact graph/returns, simultaneous
3.0–3.6 V rails and SINGLE 100 mV reference allocation remain conditional prototype
models, not measured waveforms, guaranteed load-edge behavior or lifetime proof.
Full LS43/LS33 finished-top/holes/web/annulus/pose/seat/pool/underside/service limits
and all original operating requirements remain conjunctive.

      "rationale": "I independently reviewed the actual indexed D3 successor, its full recipient role/index/status/runtime/calculation closure, current accepted assembly/fabrication identities, source/history applicability and all three final independent focused reports. I opened both recipient PCB and schematic entrypoints only in a byte-checked complete disposable archive copy, inspected both populated isometric views and the current carrier front-copper PDF, and reconciled the focused reviewers' full actual pin/electrical, eight-layer/layout, 41-document-page, registered STEP/view/model/limitation and strict CSV judgments rather than adopting author claims or blanket historical PASS. All 435 owner-derived completeness units are accounted for: current status/index/runtime, eight editable native roles, 72 concrete calculation entries and 352 byte-identical artifact aliases; resources and complete exact tools/source dependencies are retained. Every one of the 5,293 actual file hashes, all 4,938 origins, aliases and 428 index targets matches the frozen record; initial, post-inspection and successful public-verify subject maps are exactly equal, with no extra, missing or stale member. Actual public build and full live-plus-guarded offline verify exited 0 without signals; raw verify binds both boards, current c233 assembly receipt, denied original-workspace access and the exact retained NVIDIA renderer profile. Source handoff and current reasoning select actual FR8 D3 broad-copper/conditional thermal evidence, FR9 routing/layout and FR10 registered assembly, explicitly superseding tiny-land 55 K/W and pending-R3 claims while preserving history. The two actual D3 supply-net outer regions provide the missing broad heat path; independently reviewed 110 K/W/+20 C prototype allocation, restricted/failing sensitivities, complete full-load requirements and calibrated later falsifiers remain conditional, not guaranteed or measured temperatures.
